ns2:course.label: Intermediate Heat Transfer
ns2:course.description: Conduction heat transfer, radiation heat transfer, mass transfer, phase change, heat exchangers; numerical methods. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ME 310 and ME 320.
